title: Daily Devotional #12
paragraphs: As I read through Matthew chapter 12, I am struck by the ways in which Jesus challenges the religious leaders of his time and invites his followers to deepen their faith and commitment to him.

One of the most powerful moments in this chapter is when Jesus heals a man with a withered hand on the Sabbath. The Pharisees are outraged by this, as they believe it is against the law to perform any work on the Sabbath. But Jesus reminds them that it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath, and that compassion and mercy are at the heart of God's law.

This passage reminds me that sometimes we can get so caught up in rules and regulations that we forget about the most important thing - love. Jesus shows us that love and mercy are at the center of God's will for our lives, and that sometimes we need to break the rules in order to show that love to others.

Another important lesson from this chapter is the importance of bearing good fruit. Jesus tells us that a tree is known by its fruit, and that a good tree will produce good fruit. This reminds me that it is not enough to simply say that we believe in you, Lord - we must also live out that faith in our actions and our words.

As I reflect on this chapter, I am reminded of the incredible love and compassion that you have for us, God. You sent your son to heal the sick, to feed the hungry, and to bring salvation to all people. Help me to follow in Jesus' footsteps, to love others as he loved us, and to bear good fruit in all that I do.
Thank you for this powerful reminder of your love and grace. May I always seek to live out that love in my life, and may my words and actions be a reflection of your mercy and compassion.
